description:
POSITION SUMMARY

Natera is seeking a highly technical, hands-on Principal Software Engineer in Test to define and own the end-to-end test automation strategy across all products in the Women's Health, Organ Health, and EB (WH/OH/EB) vertical. In this role, you will design, build, and maintain scalable backend automation suites to validate critical workflows across distributed microservice architectures, guaranteeing data integrity from order entry and lab processing to clinical reporting. You will drive innovation by leveraging AI-assisted practices and large language models to automate test case generation, streamline log analysis, and enhance CI/CD execution speed.

As a Principal level individual contributor, you will set technical direction for quality engineering across multiple teams. You will partner with engineering, bioinformatics, laboratory operations, and Quality Assurance and Regulatory Affairs (QA/RA) leaders, and mentor engineers to build quality into the development process instead of inspecting it at the end. As a principal-level individual contributor, you will set technical direction and serve as a key organizational voice across teams. You will leverage strong interpersonal skills, clear communication, and deep technical credibility to align engineering groups, establish architectural standards, and elevate quality practices through peer leadership and technical influence.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Architect, build, and maintain a shared, reusable end-to-end test automation framework covering UI, API, event-driven/messaging, data pipeline, and integration testing across complex distributed systems.
  • Integrate automated testing into the GitLab CI/CD pipelines so that tests run on every change, report clearly, and block releases on regression.
  • Design and stand up ephemeral and persistent test environments, along with service virtualization and mocking for upstream and downstream dependencies.
  • Implement tools and procedures to maintain persistent test environments including, but not limited to, configuration settings, infrastructure updates and removal of deprecated services or tools.
  • Establish test data management practices, including synthetic and de-identified data, version-controlled fixtures, and automated loading of golden datasets into pipelines under test.
  • Partner with bioinformatics scientists and verification and validation teams to automate execution of golden-dataset regression suites against bioinformatics pipelines and to track concordance over time.
  • Ensure automated testing produces objective evidence that satisfies design control and regulatory requirements, including requirements-to-test traceability, verification reports, and audit-ready records.
  • Drive non-functional testing strategy: performance, load, reliability, and security testing in collaboration with platform and security teams.
  • Set coding standards, review practices, and patterns for test code, and evaluate and introduce new tools where they materially improve speed or coverage.
  • Mentor Software Engineers in Test and developers; lead communities of practice and help teams adopt shift-left testing.
  • Analyze defect trends and escaped defects, lead root cause analysis, and drive systemic improvements.
  • Act as the senior technical voice for quality in planning, design reviews, and release decisions.
  • Perform debugging and root cause analysis of product issues or defects.
  • Perform system analysis, assess risk, and develop strong test strategies by analyzing product design and technical specifications, and by collaborating with product managers and developers.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • BS in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent work experience. 
  • 15+ years of hands-on experience in software development or test automation, with a strong track record of building and scaling test frameworks for enterprise-grade distributed systems..
  • Demonstrated track record of designing and leading adoption of a test automation framework across multiple teams or products, not just contributing to one.
  • Experience testing complex, distributed, multi-service systems end to end, including asynchronous and event-driven architectures.
  • Experience working in a regulated environment (CLIA/CAP laboratory, medical device, pharma, or similar) is strongly preferred.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES

  • Expert-level programming skills in Java and/or Python, and the ability to write production-quality test code.
  • Deep hands-on experience with modern automation tools and libraries, such as Playwright, Selenium, JUnit/TestNG, pytest, REST Assured, and contract testing (for example, Pact).
  • Experience testing Kafka or other messaging systems, REST/gRPC APIs, and data pipelines.
  • Strong CI/CD experience (GitLab CI preferred), plus Docker and Kubernetes, and infrastructure-as-code for test environments.
  • Experience with AWS and cloud-native test environment design.
  • Strong SQL skills and experience validating data integrity across systems.
  • Strong knowledge of Linux and command-line scripting.
  • Familiarity with IEC 62304, ISO 13485, FDA 21 CFR Part 11 and Part 820, and computer system validation concepts.
  • Experience with test management and traceability tools (for example, Jama, Jira/Xray, TestRail).
  • Exposure to bioinformatics pipelines, LIMS, or genomic data formats (FASTQ, BAM, VCF) is a plus; no biology background required.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to influence engineering leaders and explain quality risk to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Pragmatic judgment about where automation pays off and where it does not.
  • Solid understanding of QA methodologies, test planning, system dependencies, and product integration phases.
The pay range is listed and actual compensation packages are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years & depth of experience, certifications and specific office location. This may differ in other locations due to cost of labor considerations.
Remote USA
$124,800—$156,000 USD

OUR OPPORTUNITY

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you’ll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, you’ll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management.

WHAT WE OFFER

Competitive Benefits - Employee benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and disability plans for eligible employees and their dependents. Additionally, Natera employees and their immediate families receive free testing in addition to fertility care benefits. Other benefits include pregnancy and baby bonding leave, 401k benefits, commuter benefits and much more. We also offer a generous employee referral program!

For more information, visit www.natera.com.

Natera is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace environment, and welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives. Inclusive collaboration benefits our employees, our community and our patients, and is critical to our mission of changing the management of disease worldwide.

All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply, and will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, age, veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with applicable laws.

If you are based in California, we encourage you to read this important information for California residents. 

Link: https://www.natera.com/notice-of-data-collection-california-residents/

Please be advised that Natera will reach out to candidates with a @natera.com email domain ONLY. Email communications from all other domain names are not from Natera or its employees and are fraudulent. Natera does not request interviews via text messages and does not ask for personal information until a candidate has engaged with the company and has spoken to a recruiter and the hiring team. Natera takes cyber crimes seriously, and will collaborate with law enforcement authorities to prosecute any related cyber crimes.
